headline: The lamp holds the only hour.
body: A moth circles once and settles on the shade. The street below shows only the wet gleam of earlier rain. The page remains open at the same line.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: overcast, the moon a soft bruise behind cloud

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: empty except for a parked taxi with its light off

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: one warm pool on the desk, edges sharp
